Hi Sanjay / Emily,

Thanks again for the call this morning - appreciated the deep context on your production constraints and regulatory needs. Below is a concise recap of what we heard, and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum.

Recap of pain & goals
- Primary pain: intermittent spikes during peak hours that cause timeouts and high latency for clinical workflows (affecting charting & triage).
- Data classification: model inputs/responses will include PHI; Horizon needs tenant isolation and encryption-at-rest + in-transit.
- Throughput target: support steady-state ~60 requests/sec for our 512-token average prompt, with bursts up to 180 req/sec for short windows.
- Latency target: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 120ms for short responses; P99 SLO is important for patient-facing flows.
- Cost sensitivity: looking for predictable unit economics (committed pricing / reserved capacity) rather than variable spot pricing.

Proposed dedicated capacity configuration (initial)
- Reserved: 8x A100 80GB-equivalent GPUs (configured as a single isolated pool).
- Autoscale burst: allow temporary burst to 12 GPUs for scheduled peak windows (configurable time windows).
- Isolation: private VPC + dedicated tenancy, customer-controlled networking, and KMS integration for key management.
- Performance optimizations: prefix/KV caching for common prompts, continuous batching tuned for your request distribution, and quantization to reduce memory footprint where acceptable.
- SLA targets: 99.9% uptime for dedicated pool; p95 latency target < 120ms under normal load.

Next steps & asks
1) Technical deep-dive: Connor O'Brien (our infra SE) to scope integration points and network reqs - can we book 60-90 minutes next week?
2) Security/compliance: we'll send SOC 2 and encryption docs; please list any additional controls / questionnaires (e.g., HITRUST) you need.
3) Procurement: attached is a draft SOW and a capacity plan with committed pricing and options for burst credits. Please share the right procurement contact and timing.
4) Timeline: ballpark delivery - provisioning and initial validation in 3-4 weeks after PO + IP/C network is finalized.

Attachments: redwood-proposed-sow-horizon-20260730.pdf, horizon-capacity-plan-20260730.xlsx

Thanks - I'll follow up with calendar options for the technical deep-dive.

Best,

- Pricing & burst credits: the attached SOW includes burst credits and a monthly committed minimum (see section 2.1). We can make the burst policy explicit in the SOW (time windows & max burst size).

Connor - could you prepare: (a) a 1-pager GPU sizing comparison (A100 vs H100 for Horizon's workload), (b) expected p95/p99 latency numbers for the proposed config with current token profile, and (c) a checklist for network/firewall requirements so Horizon's infra team can provision prior to provisioning?

Proposed deep-dive slots: Tue Aug 4 14:00-15:30 PT or Wed Aug 5 13:00-14:30 PT. Please let me know which works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Hi all - quick technical notes ahead of the deep-dive:

1) GPU sizing rationale
- 8x A100 80GB: gives a balance of memory for KV cache + multi-model support; expected to hit your steady-state throughput (~60 rps) with headroom for batching.
- 4x H100: we'll see higher raw throughput but will need to validate model compatibility and memory/quantization tradeoffs; could reduce cost per request in some workloads.

2) Latency expectations (estimates, to be validated in bench)
- Steady-state (60 rps): p50 ~ 30-45ms, p95 ~ 80-120ms.
- Burst scenarios: p95 may increase if KV cache cold-starts; recommend warm-up strategy and scheduled pre-warming for known peak windows.

3) Networking & isolation checklist
- Dedicated VPC peering or PrivateLink (customer choice).
- Customer-managed KMS (we support AWS/Azure/GCP KMS + HSM integrations).
- IP allowlists, mTLS for control-plane where required, and SFTP/secure transfer for initial model artifacts.

4) Scaling plan
- Provision initial 8-GPU pool; enable autoscale policy with burst to 12 GPUs for X hours per day.
- Implement health checks and fallback routing to a cheaper model variant if SLA is at risk.

I'll prepare the A100 vs H100 1-pager and latency model to send before the deep-dive. Looking forward to the call - either Tue Aug 4 14:00-15:30 PT works for me.

Thanks,
